title: Portugal great Cristiano Ronaldo announces his retirement from international soccer
summary: Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Thursday he won't play for Portugal anymore, ending a career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men's all-time international scoring…

image.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo, shown in this October 2025 file photo, announced in a video message posted to social media on Thursday that he won't play for Portugal anymore. (Getty Images)

blocks.text: Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Thursday he won't play for Portugal anymore, ending a career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men's all-time international scoring record.
Veteran striker walked out on the national team after falling out with coach in September
It was a sad ending to a lauded career that began more than two decades ago before Euro 2004 and finished with him walking out on the national team after falling out with coach Jorge Jesus.

items: Ronaldo quits Portugal camp after learning he won't start game, vows to one day tell truth over exit

blocks.text: "To the Portuguese people, the day has come for me to hand back the No. 7 shirt of our national team," the 41-year-old Ronaldo said in a long video message on social media.
"I never felt it belonged to me alone but for 23 years I had the privilege and the responsibility of wearing it, defending it and carrying it with me into stadiums all around the world."
